title: Sell Mineral Rights in Platteville, CO
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Platteville, CO | DJ Basin
metaDescription: Hold minerals near Platteville, CO, site of an early Colorado oil discovery? We check that long production history before quoting your interest.
heroLead: Platteville sits along the South Platte in ground with one of the longer oil and gas histories in the DJ Basin, where vertical wells drilled decades before the modern Niobrara boom already knew this formation could produce.
intro: This part of Weld County has been part of the state's oil and gas story since well before horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing transformed the Wattenberg field starting in the 2000s and 2010s. If your mineral interest near Platteville traces back to an original vertical well from decades ago, it may have been re-drilled, recompleted, or simply sit alongside newer horizontal wells developed on the same or an adjacent spacing unit.

sections.heading: Layered development over decades
paragraphs: It's common around Platteville to find a section with an older vertical well from the 1970s or 1980s alongside a modern horizontal completed within the last decade, sometimes on the same or overlapping spacing unit after operators consolidated leases. That layering can make ownership tracing more involved, since your interest may be tied to production history spanning very different eras.
We pull the full COGCC well history for your section, not only the most recent well, to make sure we're accounting for everything tied to your legal description.

sections.heading: What determines your quote
paragraphs: Current production from whichever wells are active on your unit, along with each well's stage on its decline curve. Older wells long past their productive life don't add much to the number; recent horizontals still early in production add considerably more.

faqs.question: Does having an older well on my section complicate a sale?
faqs.answer: Not usually — it just means we trace the full production history rather than just the most recent well before quoting your interest.

faqs.question: How far back does oil and gas history go around Platteville?
faqs.answer: Decades, with vertical wells drilled well before the modern horizontal Niobrara boom that built out much of the rest of the Wattenberg field.

faqs.question: Will an old, mostly depleted well drag down my value?
faqs.answer: A depleted well contributes little on its own, but if a newer horizontal is also active on your unit, that's what largely drives current value.

faqs.question: How do I know if my acreage has vertical and horizontal wells both?
faqs.answer: We pull the full COGCC well index for your section, which lists every well ever permitted there regardless of vintage, so nothing gets missed in the valuation.

faqs.question: Is Platteville's older history a plus or a minus for value?
faqs.answer: Neither by itself — it just means we look at a longer and sometimes more complicated production record before quoting, rather than a single recent well's numbers.
